snippet.title: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call Official Gameplay Trailer | Cosmic Survival Horror
snippet.description:
We are excited to announce that our psychological horror adventure Life & Shadow: Celestial Call is coming to Steam and is now waiting for your wishlists!

🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702120/Life__Shadow_Celestial_Call/

🧪 About the Game:
You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil.
By day, you plan your survival, maintain the systems, and tend to what keeps the observatory alive.
By night, you descend toward the basement, where whispers seep through the walls and the shadows grow closer with every passing night.
Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery behind the celestial call?

🌾 Gather and prepare during the day
🧹 Clear the waste and keep the observatory running
🔭 Use the telescope and strange symbols to piece together the truth
🔦 Descend into the basement at night and face what lurks below
🧠 Try to keep your sanity as the line between calm and paranoia fades

✨ Key Features:

A psychological horror experience where calm daylight slowly turns into paranoia-filled nights

Dynamic day/night cycle: daytime tasks and preparation, nighttime basement exploration and tense puzzle-solving

Light crafting and resource management: keep the observatory powered, maintain the systems, and improve your chances of survival

Story-rich progression: uncover a fractured story through telescope observations, cryptic symbols, and forgotten notes

Atmospheric sound design and environmental storytelling that constantly challenge your sense of safety

Multiple endings shaped by the choices you make

🎮 Add Life & Shadow: Celestial Call to your wishlist now and don’t miss any updates!

Stay tuned for the latest news and updates about Life & Shadow: Celestial Call.
The observatory is waiting, and the stars are calling—make sure you’re there to answer.

🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702120/Life__Shadow_Celestial_Call/

🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/Y5yahQ7Ws5
